signals.text: 1 open PM role across 2 US offices

bullets: Own and evolve Finch's HR & Pay integrations across auth, coverage expansion, writeback, and data sync - critical building blocks of our platform.
Partner closely with Engineering to shape the strategy for integration architecture and data sync infrastructure, ensuring scalability, high performance, and reliability.
Define and track key product metrics and use data to inform decisions, prioritization, and success criteria.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Marketing to align customer feedback with product development.
Champion developer experience by delivering clear documentation, easy onboarding, and fast issue resolution.
